_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every price SciTeX publishes. Operator decision 2026-08-01: 「SSOT にしましょう」 / 「価格はjson あたりにしておくと使いやすいかと」. Before this file, /services/ hard-coded 9 JPY rows in its template and /landing/ hard-coded 12 USD items in its view; the two disagreed by up to 2.7x on the same service. Change a number HERE and it reaches every page and the brochure PDF together. A literal price anywhere else is a bug — tests/scitex_hub/public_app/test_pricing_ssot.py enforces it.
_amount_is_the_only_truth: Store the NUMBER, never a formatted string. Rendering derives '無料' from amount 0, the '〜' suffix from from_price, and the '月額' prefix from unit. Storing both 11000 and '11,000円' would be two representations of one fact, which is the duplication this file exists to remove.
tax_note: 表示価格はすべて税込(総額)です。

Each names a `price_ref` into `consulting` above, because /services/ previously printed the same band in FOUR places — the desktop comparison table and the mobile card, for each of three plans — all hand-typed. Changing a band would have updated the price table and silently left the plan cards showing the old figure. A reference cannot drift from what it references.

_subscription_status.note: NO subscription tiers are published. This is deliberate and must stay consistent with two other places: BILLING_PLANS (settings_commerce.py) resolves to [] so /pricing/ lists nothing, and /特商法/ states 「有料プランは現在準備中です…現在提供中の機能は無料でご利用いただけます」 — which is the legally operative disclosure. /landing/ previously contradicted both by advertising a $29-$999 ladder. Do not add tiers here without updating BILLING_PLANS and the 特商法 wording in the same change; a site that both denies and advertises paid plans is the defect this key exists to prevent.
